faq_how_to_start: How do I start playing Build a Base and Steal?
faq_how_to_start_answer: Start by rolling for your first pets using the free currency. Build a simple base to protect them, then begin earning passive income. As you accumulate wealth, invest in better pets and stronger base defenses.
faq_best_pets: What are the best pets to roll for?
faq_best_pets_answer: Legendary Brainrots offer the highest income multipliers but are expensive to roll. Start with Epic and Mythic pets for better value, then save for Legendary pets once you have a stable income stream.
faq_base_protection: How do I protect my base from raids?
faq_base_protection_answer: Use maze-like layouts, multiple layers of walls, and strategic trap placement. Compact bases are harder to navigate, while maze bases confuse raiders. Balance defense cost with the value of pets you're protecting.
faq_offline_income_answer: Your pets continue generating income even when you're offline. The amount depends on pet rarity, quantity, and any boost items. Income caps at 12 hours offline, so log in regularly to collect maximum earnings.
faq_raiding_tips: What are the best raiding strategies?
faq_raiding_tips_answer: Scout targets first to assess their defenses. Use appropriate gear for different base types — infiltration tools for mazes, weapons for direct assaults. Time your raids when targets are likely to have accumulated wealth.
faq_codes_working_answer: Currently, there are no active working codes. Codes are released periodically by the developer, so check back regularly or join the community Discord for updates on new code releases.
faq_private_server: Should I use a private server?
faq_private_server_answer: Private servers are great for practicing base designs and testing strategies without risk. They also allow you to play with friends and test collaborative base layouts. However, you'll earn less progression compared to public servers.
faq_rebirth_system: Is there a rebirth or prestige system?
faq_rebirth_system_answer: The game features progression through pet collection and base upgrades. Focus on building a strong pet collection and impenetrable base rather than resetting progress. Advanced players can challenge themselves with specialized goals.

category_intro_beginner-guide: Welcome to Build a Base and Steal! This beginner guide covers everything you need to know for your first session - from rolling your first pets to building your first base. The core gameplay loop involves collecting pets that generate passive income, building defenses to protect them, and raiding other players to steal valuable pets. Master this cycle to become the ultimate base builder and raider.
category_feature_beginner-guide_html:
StepActionPriority
1Roll initial pets with starter cashHighest
2Build simple base around petsHigh
3Wait for offline income accumulationMedium
4Roll for better pets with accumulated cashHigh
5Upgrade base defensesMedium
category_mechanics_beginner-guide: Start by using your initial cash to roll for pets. Even common pets generate income, so build a collection quickly. Place pets in a simple base layout - just walls around them initially. As income accumulates, reinvest in rolling for rarer pets and improving your base defense. The key is balancing progression between pet quality and base security.
category_advantages_beginner-guide: Following this roadmap gives you a strong foundation for long-term success. Early focus on building a diverse pet collection and basic defense prevents common beginner mistakes. Understanding the core cycle early accelerates progression and makes the game more enjoyable.
category_weaknesses_beginner-guide: New players often focus too much on rolling and neglect defense, making them easy raid targets. Others over-invest in defense too early, slowing pet collection. Finding the right balance takes practice and experimentation with different strategies.
category_faq_beginner-guide_a1: Roll for pets immediately with your starting cash. Even common pets generate income. Build a simple base around them to protect from raids. Wait for offline income to accumulate, then reinvest in better rolls and defense upgrades.
category_faq_beginner-guide_q2: How much should I invest in defense early?
category_faq_beginner-guide_a2: Start with basic walls around your pets. Don't overspend on complex defenses initially - focus on building a diverse pet collection first. Gradually improve defenses as your pet values increase and become more attractive raid targets.
category_faq_beginner-guide_a3: Start raiding once you have basic gear and some pets to protect. Raid early but conservatively - target weaker bases first to learn mechanics. As you gain experience and better gear, target more valuable bases. Raiding is essential for progression.
category_qt_beginner-guide_0: Prioritize pet collection over complex defense early
category_qt_beginner-guide_1: Check for free codes before spending cash
category_qt_beginner-guide_2: Log in regularly to collect offline income
category_intro_pet-rolling: Pet rolling is the core progression mechanic in Build a Base and Steal. Each roll costs cash and has a chance to drop pets of different rarities - from common to legendary. Higher rarity pets generate more passive income and are more valuable. Understanding drop rates, budget planning, and rolling strategies is essential for efficiently building a strong pet collection.

category_mechanics_pet-rolling: Each roll costs a fixed amount of cash and has predetermined drop rates for each rarity tier. The rolling system uses RNG (random number generation) to determine the outcome. Save cash for bulk rolling sessions rather than individual rolls - this improves consistency and helps balance out RNG variance. Track your rolling results to identify patterns and optimize your budget allocation.
category_advantages_pet-rolling: Strategic rolling accelerates progression significantly. Focus on building a diverse collection first, then target specific high-value pets. Understanding drop rates helps set realistic goals and budget expectations. A balanced collection of different rarities provides stable income while hunting for legendaries.
category_weaknesses_pet-rolling: RNG can be unpredictable - you may go long periods without rare drops, making progress feel slow. Overspending on chasing legendaries can drain your budget and weaken defenses. The system requires patience and discipline to stick to your rolling budget.
category_faq_pet-rolling_a1: Save cash for bulk rolling sessions of 50-100 rolls rather than individual rolls. This reduces RNG variance and provides more consistent results. Start with a goal of building a diverse collection across all rarities, then focus on hunting specific high-value pets.
category_faq_pet-rolling_q2: How much should I budget for rolling?
category_faq_pet-rolling_a2: Allocate 60-70% of your income to rolling, 20-30% to base defense, and keep 10% as emergency reserves. Adjust ratios based on your progression stage - early game focus more on rolling, late game balance more towards defense and raiding.
category_faq_pet-rolling_a3: Yes, luck boost items temporarily improve your drop rates, especially for higher rarity tiers. They're most effective when used during bulk rolling sessions. Save luck boosts for when you have substantial cash saved for maximum efficiency.
category_qt_pet-rolling_0: Bulk roll in sessions, not individual rolls
category_qt_pet-rolling_1: Track results to identify patterns and variance
category_qt_pet-rolling_2: Balance rolling budget with defense spending
category_intro_base-defense: Base defense is crucial for protecting your valuable pets from raids. Effective base design combines wall placement, traps, defensive structures, and strategic layout to create fortresses that are difficult to infiltrate. A well-defended base deters raiders and minimizes pet theft, allowing your income generation to continue uninterrupted.
category_feature_base-defense_html:
DesignEffectivenessCost

Trap-Focused LayoutMediumLow
Compact FortressHighMedium
category_mechanics_base-defense: Base defense works by forcing raiders to navigate through walls, traps, and defensive structures before reaching your pets. Each defensive element has different effects - walls block paths, traps damage raiders, and defensive structures provide protection bonuses. Strategic placement maximizes effectiveness and creates multiple layers of defense.
category_advantages_base-defense: Strong base defense protects your investment in pets and ensures continuous income generation. Deters casual raiders and makes targeted raids more expensive. Well-designed bases can often defend against stronger raiders through strategic layout rather than raw defensive power.
category_weaknesses_base-defense: Complex bases are expensive to build and maintain. Over-investing in defense early can slow pet collection. Some raiders have specialized gear and strategies that can counter specific base types. No base is completely impenetrable - determined raiders will eventually find weaknesses.
category_faq_base-defense_a1: Maze labyrinths are most effective but expensive. Multi-layer defense offers good balance of protection and cost. Start with compact designs for early game, upgrade to maze layouts as your pet values increase. Adapt your design to counter common raiding strategies.
category_faq_base-defense_q2: How much should I spend on defense?
category_faq_base-defense_a2: Spend 20-30% of your income on defense upgrades, scaling up as your pets become more valuable. Early game focus on basic walls, mid-game add traps, late game invest in complex layouts. Match defense investment to the value of assets you're protecting.
category_faq_base-defense_q3: Do traps work against all raiders?
category_faq_base-defense_a3: Traps are effective but some raiders have counter-gear like shields or advanced tools. Combine traps with walls and defensive structures for layered protection. Place traps strategically in chokepoints where raiders must pass through for maximum effectiveness.
category_qt_base-defense_0: Create multiple layers, not just outer perimeter
category_qt_base-defense_1: Use traps in chokepoints for maximum effect
category_qt_base-defense_2: Regularly update defenses as raiders adapt
category_intro_raiding: Raiding allows you to steal valuable pets from other players' bases. Success requires strategic gear selection, understanding base layouts, and effective infiltration tactics. Raiding is essential for accelerating progression by acquiring high-value pets without spending cash on rolling. Master raiding mechanics to become a formidable base infiltrator.

category_mechanics_raiding: Raiding involves infiltrating other players' bases to reach and steal their pets. Each base has different defenses and layouts that require specific strategies. Gear items provide advantages like increased wall damage, defense bypass, or faster extraction. Scouting targets before attacking helps assess defenses and choose the right gear and approach.
category_advantages_raiding: Successful raids provide high-value pets without rolling costs, accelerating progression dramatically. Raiding income supplements passive income generation. Develops skill in base analysis and strategic thinking. High-value targets can provide progression equivalent to hundreds of rolls.
category_weaknesses_raiding: Failed raids waste gear and resources. Strong bases can be nearly impenetrable without specific counter-gear. Raiding can be time-intensive scouting targets. Risk of retaliation if you raid players who then target your base. Requires significant gear investment to be effective.
category_faq_raiding_q1: How do I choose raid targets?
category_faq_raiding_a1: Scout targets first to assess their defenses and pet values. Look for bases with high-value pets but weaker defenses. Avoid heavily fortified bases unless you have specific counter-gear. Balance risk vs reward - sometimes smaller, easier targets provide better consistent returns.
category_faq_raiding_a2: Match gear to base type - infiltration tools for mazes, advanced weapons for multi-layer defenses. Start with basic weapons, upgrade as you progress. Always carry extraction tools for faster theft. Balance gear cost with potential rewards from the target.
category_faq_raiding_a3: Target players who are inactive or have weaker defenses to minimize retaliation risk. Don't repeatedly raid the same players. Maintain strong base defense to deter counter-raids. Consider raiding during off-peak hours when target players are less likely to be online.
category_qt_raiding_1: Match gear to base type for efficiency
category_qt_raiding_2: Balance raid aggression with defense maintenance
category_intro_offline-money: Offline income allows your pets to continue generating cash even when you're not actively playing. This is a key progression mechanic that rewards regular play while providing flexibility for real-life schedules. Understanding offline income mechanics, maximizing generation rates, and optimal collection strategies significantly accelerates your overall progression.

category_mechanics_offline-money: Offline income is calculated based on your pets' rarity, quantity, and any active boost items at the moment you log off. Each pet generates income at its base rate, modified by rarity multipliers. Income accumulates over time but is capped at 12 hours - after that, no additional income is generated until you log in and collect.
category_advantages_offline-money: Maximizing offline income provides steady progression even with limited playtime. Regular collection prevents hitting the 12-hour cap and ensures continuous income flow. Strategic timing of log-off with boost items active significantly increases accumulated earnings. Passive income continues while focusing on base defense or raiding.
category_weaknesses_offline-money: 12-hour cap means longer offline periods waste potential income. Requires regular login schedule for maximum efficiency. Income rate depends on pet collection strength - weak pets generate minimal offline income. Boost items expire if not collected timely, reducing efficiency.
category_faq_offline-money_q1: How often should I collect offline income?
category_faq_offline-money_a1: Log in at least every 12 hours to collect offline income and reset the cap. For maximum efficiency, collect every 4-6 hours to avoid the diminishing returns that kick in after 8 hours. Set reminders if needed to maintain optimal collection schedule.
category_faq_offline-money_a2: Yes, boost items that are active when you log off continue to affect offline income generation. Time log-off periods to coincide with active boosts for maximum accumulated earnings. However, boost effects expire over time, so they won't last through extended offline periods.
category_faq_offline-money_q3: How can I increase offline income?
category_faq_offline-money_a3: Focus on acquiring higher rarity pets with better income multipliers. Maintain a large collection of pets rather than just a few high-value ones. Use income boost items strategically before logging off. Regularly upgrade your pet collection to increase base income generation rates.
category_qt_offline-money_0: Log in at least every 12 hours to avoid cap
category_qt_offline-money_1: Time log-off with active boosts for maximum gain
category_qt_offline-money_2: Focus on collection size, not just individual pet value

category_faq_pets-list_q2: How many pets should I collect?

category_intro_gear: Gear items provide tactical advantages in both base defense and raiding. Weapons damage enemy walls and structures, shields protect against damage, tools offer specialized abilities like infiltration or extraction, and boosts provide temporary enhancements to various game mechanics. Strategic gear usage is essential for advanced gameplay.
category_mechanics_gear: Gear items have specific effects and durations. Weapons deal damage to walls and structures during raids, with higher-tier weapons dealing more damage. Shields reduce incoming damage from raids and other sources. Tools provide specialized abilities like bypassing defenses or faster extraction. Boosts offer temporary enhancements to luck, income, or other mechanics.
category_advantages_gear: Proper gear selection significantly improves raiding success rates. Defensive gear protects valuable pets from raids. Specialized tools provide strategic advantages against specific base types. Boosts accelerate progression when used strategically. Gear investment provides long-term gameplay benefits.
category_weaknesses_gear: Gear items can be expensive, especially high-tier items. Single-use items like boosts provide temporary benefits only. Gear effectiveness depends on proper usage - using the wrong gear wastes resources. Maintaining a diverse gear inventory requires ongoing investment.
category_faq_gear_a1: Start with basic weapons and shields for raiding and defense. Progress to advanced weapons as you encounter stronger bases. Invest in infiltration tools for maze bases and extraction tools for faster raids. Use boosts strategically during key rolling or raiding sessions.
category_faq_gear_a2: Weapons and shields are permanent items that don't expire. Tools are also permanent but may have limited uses or cooldowns. Boosts are temporary - typically lasting 30 minutes to 2 hours depending on the specific boost. Plan boost usage carefully for maximum effectiveness.
category_faq_gear_a3: Yes, gear can be upgraded to higher tiers with improved stats and effects. Upgrading requires investment but provides long-term benefits. Prioritize upgrading your most frequently used gear items. Check upgrade costs vs benefits to ensure efficient resource allocation.
category_qt_gear_0: Match gear to specific base types for maximum efficiency
category_qt_gear_1: Invest in permanent gear over consumable boosts
category_qt_gear_2: Upgrade frequently used gear for long-term benefits

Bulk rolling uses statistical analysis to maximize legendary drops over time. Advanced base design incorporates psychological elements to confuse raiders. Coordinated raids team up with other players for maximum effectiveness. Resource management balances multiple progression paths simultaneously.
category_advantages_strategies: Advanced strategies significantly accelerate progression and competitive advantage. Optimized approaches reduce waste and improve efficiency across all game systems. High-level gameplay techniques provide satisfaction and mastery. Strategic thinking outperforms brute force approaches in the long term.
category_weaknesses_strategies: Advanced strategies require significant experience and game knowledge to implement effectively. Some approaches have high learning curves and failure rates during practice. Coordinated strategies depend on finding reliable teammates. Over-optimization can reduce flexibility and adaptation to changing situations.
category_faq_strategies_q1: What's the most important advanced strategy?
category_faq_strategies_a1: Bulk rolling optimization is the most impactful - it dramatically improves legendary acquisition rates over time. Base design follows closely as it protects your investments. Focus on mastering these two first, then progress to raiding and resource management strategies.
category_faq_strategies_q2: How do I find teammates for coordinated raids?
category_faq_strategies_a2: Join the official Discord community and look for raiding groups or teams. Many experienced players organize coordinated raids for better loot distribution. Build relationships with reliable players who complement your gear and playstyle.
category_faq_strategies_q3: When should I switch from basic to advanced strategies?
category_faq_strategies_a3: Transition to advanced strategies once you have a stable foundation: 15+ pets, basic base defense, and consistent income generation. Advanced strategies amplify existing strength but require resources and experience to implement effectively.
category_qt_strategies_0: Master fundamentals before attempting advanced techniques
category_qt_strategies_1: Track and analyze results to optimize strategies
category_qt_strategies_2: Build community connections for coordinated gameplay

category_advantages_faq: Quick access to reliable answers saves time and frustration. Covers both basic and advanced topics for all player levels. Community-driven content addresses real player concerns. Regularly updated based on new game features and common issues.
category_weaknesses_faq: Some questions may become outdated as game mechanics change. Individual situations may vary from general advice provided. Technical solutions may not work for all devices or connection issues. Players may need to combine multiple FAQ answers for complex problems.
category_faq_faq_a1: Game lag can be caused by device performance, internet connection, or server load. Try lowering graphics settings, closing other apps, or switching to a less crowded server. If issues persist, it may be a temporary server problem - check official channels for status updates.
category_faq_faq_a2: For technical issues, contact Roblox support directly. For game-specific questions or bug reports, use the official Discord channel or contact the developer through their social media. Include screenshots and detailed descriptions of issues for faster resolution.
category_faq_faq_a3: Build a Base and Steal is primarily free-to-play with optional purchases. While premium items can accelerate progression, dedicated free players can achieve success through strategic gameplay and time investment. The game balances free and paid content to maintain fair competition.
category_qt_faq_0: Check official channels for known issues and fixes
category_qt_faq_1: Provide detailed information when reporting bugs
category_qt_faq_2: Game knowledge matters more than spending money

category_mechanics_updates: Updates introduce new pets, gear, base elements, and gameplay mechanics. Balance adjustments modify drop rates, income values, and other progression parameters. Content updates add new features and expand gameplay options. Developer announcements communicate changes and planned future updates.
category_advantages_updates: Staying updated ensures your strategies remain effective against current game mechanics. New content provides fresh gameplay opportunities and progression paths. Early adopters of new features gain competitive advantages. Understanding changes helps adapt gameplay for optimal progression.
category_weaknesses_updates: Frequent updates require adapting strategies, which can be disruptive. Balance changes may nerf previously effective approaches. New content may have bugs or imbalances initially. Learning new mechanics takes time and experimentation.
category_faq_updates_a1: Major updates occur every 1-2 months, with smaller balance patches and bug fixes weekly. Special events may bring additional updates. Follow official Discord for update announcements and detailed patch notes with exact timing and content details.
category_faq_updates_a2: No, updates never reset player progress. Your pets, base, and resources are preserved through all updates. However, balance changes may affect the effectiveness or value of certain items, requiring strategy adjustments to maintain optimal progression.
category_faq_updates_a3: Share feature suggestions on the official Discord server or developer social media channels. The development team actively considers community feedback for future updates. Provide detailed, constructive suggestions with explanations of how they would improve the game.

category_intro_community: Join the Build a Base and Steal community to connect with other players, share strategies, and stay updated on game news. Community resources include Discord servers, YouTube channels, and social platforms where players discuss gameplay, share base designs, and coordinate activities. Active community participation enhances your gaming experience.

category_mechanics_community: Discord provides real-time discussion, strategy sharing, and team coordination. YouTube channels offer tutorials, gameplay guides, and entertainment content. Social media platforms share official news, update announcements, and community highlights. Each platform serves different purposes for community engagement and information sharing.
category_advantages_community: Access to collective knowledge accelerates learning and progression. Community connections provide teammates for coordinated raids and feedback on base designs. Early access to news and updates helps adapt strategies quickly. Sharing strategies and helping others creates a positive gaming environment.
category_weaknesses_community: Community information may include unverified strategies that don't work for everyone. Coordinating with others requires schedule alignment and trust. Community platforms may have toxic elements or misinformation. Over-reliance on community opinions may limit individual strategic thinking.
category_faq_community_q1: How do I join the Discord?
category_faq_community_a1: Find the official Discord invite link through the game's social media or Roblox page. Click the link, create a Discord account if needed, and join the server. Read the rules and channel descriptions to understand community guidelines and find appropriate channels for your interests.
category_faq_community_a2: Yes, the community organizes regular events including base design contests, raiding tournaments, and strategy sharing sessions. Events are announced on Discord and social media. Participating in events is great for learning, competition, and community recognition.
category_faq_community_q3: How can I contribute to the community?
category_faq_community_a3: Share your successful base designs and strategies on Discord or YouTube. Help answer questions from newer players. Participate in community events and discussions. Provide constructive feedback and suggestions. Content creators can make tutorials and guides for the community.
category_qt_community_2: Give back by helping others and sharing knowledge

Advanced guides focus on optimization and high-level tactics.
category_advantages_guides: Structured learning path accelerates progression and prevents common mistakes. Expert strategies provide competitive advantages. Comprehensive coverage ensures you find answers to all gameplay questions. Regularly updated with new content and community-discovered techniques.
category_weaknesses_guides: Some advanced guides may require significant game experience to implement effectively. Strategies may become outdated as game mechanics change. Individual results may vary based on playstyle and progression. Reading guides doesn't replace hands-on practice and experimentation.
category_faq_guides_q1: Which guide should I read first?
category_faq_guides_a1: Start with the Beginner Guide for your first session. Then read the Pet Rolling Guide to understand core progression mechanics. Follow with Base Defense and Raiding guides as you build your collection. Advanced guides are best tackled once you have a stable foundation.
category_faq_guides_a2: Yes, guides are updated after major game updates and when community discovers new strategies. Check the guide publication dates and look for recently updated content. Join the Discord community for the latest guide recommendations and updates.
category_faq_guides_a3: Yes! Community contributions are welcome. Share your successful strategies and discoveries on Discord or social media. High-quality community content may be incorporated into the official guides. Provide detailed explanations and evidence for your strategies.
